candidates.summary: no test ties icons/icons.txt to icons/vendored.svg: an icons.txt edit without `make icons` passes CI with the old icon set
candidates.failure_scenario: The documented flow is 'one line in icons.txt plus make icons' (ADR Tooling, icons.txt header, PR body). A contributor deletes `rocket` from icons.txt and skips `make icons`. TestIconTable reads vendored.svg, never icons.txt, so it stays green; `rocket` stays callable, ICONS.md keeps listing it, and icons.txt says it is gone. The ADR's 'TestIconTable fails CI when it is stale' (line 188) holds for icons_gen.go against the SVG sources only.
candidates.verify_by: grep -rn 'icons.txt' gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown/*_test.go (only the catalog prose at ext_icons_test.go:330); then delete one entry from icons/icons.txt and run go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/markdown -run 'TestIconTable$|TestIconCatalog$': expect red, observe green. The offline pin: icons.txt names in order == <symbol id="ico-NAME"> ids of vendored.svg in order, which holds today.
candidates.evidence: grep of markdown/*_test.go for icons.txt: one hit, ext_icons_test.go:330, a string in the catalog text. Offline compare at 56ff177: icons.txt names vs vendored.svg symbol ids -> 'same-order', 428 symbols, all 'viewBox=0 0 21 21 stroke-width=1.3'.

candidates.summary: 'Each icon writes up to 2.3 KB' leaves out the label: a 512-byte tag with a quote-filled label writes about 5.2 KB, so the 1,000 cap bounds icon output near 5.2 MB, over twice the figure
candidates.failure_scenario: renderIcon writes the label through gmhtml.DefaultWriter.Write (ext_icons.go:255-257), which escapes `"` to `"` (6 bytes). In `<gno-icon name=pure label='"""…' />` the 512-byte bound leaves room for about 481 quotes, so about 2.9 KB of aria-label plus pure's 2.3 KB glyph. 1,000 such lines render about 5.2 MB of icon markup. That is still under the 13 MB master page gfanton measured, so the cap holds, but the sizing the ADR records for it (and the '3.5 MB' figure built on name=pure without a label) understates the worst case.
candidates.verify_by: One-off Go test in package markdown: Convert strings.Repeat("<gno-icon name=pure label='" + strings.Repeat(`"`, 481) + "' />\n\n", 1000) through newProductionLikeMarkdown with NewGnoParserContext; expect len(out)/1000 <= 2.3 KB per the ADR, observe about 5.2 KB.
candidates.evidence: Read only: ext_icons.go:255-257 writes the raw label via gmhtml.DefaultWriter.Write; scanGnoTag (utils.go:96-102) accepts single-quoted values holding `"`; maxIconTagLen = 512 (ext_icons.go:91).
